statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) within 30 days of the rejection decision under Law on Promulgation of Legal Documents and Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13; alternatively, a lawsuit may be filed with the Administrative Court in accordance with Law on Administrative Procedures; the applicant may also resubmit a corrected name application immediately via the same portal without refund of fees.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Assessed as generally NOT permissible for a fully compliant foreign-invested LLC head office; Virtual office arrangements are risky and may be challenged because Law on Enterprises Article 43 requires a lawful headquarters address located in Viet Nam; while co-working spaces and registered service addresses are accepted provided a physical location exists, pure virtual office / mail-drop addresses without a lease agreement and physical presence are not permissible for the registered headquarters; digital content agency under ISIC 7310 is not exempt from physical commercial premise requirement; however, for ancillary outreach the business may use remote contracts, though statutory head office must be a physical leasable location.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High: Estimated 70-80% likelihood of unannounced onsite inspection in the first 12 months after incorporation by the DPI / tax authorities / market management if the registered office is identified as a virtual or shared service address; even with formal lease, risk is reduced to 25-30%; physical inspection likely triggered by discrepancies in legal representative presence or nominee filings. For MCN agencies with bank account at LCB or with TikTok Creator Payout onboarding, banks and TikTok require site visit or proof of physical operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; official electronic portal: https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn; e-invoice portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested limited liability company first obtains an Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment; the tax authority automatically issues the Tax Identification Number (Mã số thuế, MST) upon data synchronization with the national business registry. The LLC must then submit a tax registration file (Form 01-ĐK-TCT) to the local tax office to activate CIT and VAT obligations. For the supply of digital services, e-commerce, or online platform services into Viet Nam without a permanent establishment, the foreign or offshore entity (e.g., an MCN agency receiving TikToK creator payouts) must register a foreign contractor presence through the ETC portal of the General Department of Taxation (etaxportal.gdt.gov.vn) under Decree No. 85/2021/NĐ-CP and Circular No. 80/2021/TT-BTC, obtaining a dedicated foreign supplier tax code and fulfilling monthly/quarterly declaration duties.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not apply check-the-box partnership pass-through elections or hybrid mismatch elections. A VN LLC is mandatorily taxed at entity level at the 20% Enterprise Income Tax (CIT) rate. Election available: VAT method election between deduction method (input credit) and direct method (levy on value-added) subject to accounting standards compliance. Also electable: simplified transfer pricing documentation for qualifying low-risk/related-party transactions under Decree No. 132/2020/NĐ-CP; Export Processing Enterprise (EPE) status election approved by customs authorities granting 0% VAT on export sales and non-applicability of VAT on imported production inputs.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT / Thuế giá trị gia tăng - GTGT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Business households and individuals are required to register VAT once annual revenue exceeds VND 100 million; all corporations and foreign-invested LLCs must register VAT mandatorily upon incorporation regardless of revenue. Foreign suppliers of e-commerce, digital services, and platform intermediary services (including TikTok payout services to Vietnamese creators) are in all cases required to register, declare, and pay tax through the dedicated ETC portal of the General Department of Taxation even without a fixed place of business, with no de minimis turnover exemption.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT invoices must be issued as electronic invoices (hóa đơn điện tử) under Decree No. 123/2020/NĐ-CP and Circular No. 78/2021/TT-BTC. Invoices must be transmitted near-real-time to the General Department of Taxation via the hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn system; taxpayers normally generate invoices with a self-generated code after achieving compliance status, except high-risk taxpayers whose invoices are pre-coded with the tax authority's invoice code. Machine-to-machine API integration is mandatory for high-volume enterprises and for foreign digital suppliers reporting through the ETC portal; no physical stamping exists, but digital signatures (provided via USB token or cloud signing service) and standardized XML/JSON formats are obligatory; invoice data must include a verification number and be cleared by the tax authority's central invoice database prior to use.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods and services supplied to foreign organizations or individuals and physically delivered/consumed outside Viet Nam are eligible for the 0% VAT export rate. For digital creator-manager services (ISIC 7310 / MCN agency), zero-rating applies when the service is performed offshore, the recipient is a foreign party (e.g., TikTok Pte. Ltd. outside Viet Nam), and the contract, service delivery records, and offshore performance evidence demonstrate the service is not consumed in Viet Nam. Goods exported through an Export Processing Enterprise additionally qualify for export VAT zero-rating. Disbursements, intermediary commissions, or platform payouts routed to local creators remain subject to standard-rate VAT to the extent such services are consumed domestically.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai hải quan hàng hóa xuất khẩu) with customs clearance confirmation stamp
Bill of Lading (original or certified true copy) or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods

Inward Remittance Certificate / bank foreign-currency receipt certificate (chứng từ thanh toán qua ngân hàng) confirming actual remittance from the foreign buyer within the statutory repatriation window
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Any false, fraudulent, or erroneously substantiated export zero-rating claim triggers retrospective VAT reassessment and forced refund clawback, late-payment interest at 0.03% per day (approximately 10.95% per annum), administrative fines up to three times the evaded tax amount, and penalty charges under Decree No. 125/2020/NĐ-CP. Failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days (or an approved extension under Circular No. 05/2017/TT-NHNN and the Law on Foreign Exchange) also attracts customs and tax administrative sanctions. The tax authority may audit VAT refunds and export records for up to five years from the date of violation, or longer where criminal indicia exist. Aggravated, premeditated evasion invokes criminal liability under Articles 200 and 201 of the Penal Code No. 100/2015/QH13, including imprisonment of up to 20 years for the responsible officers and corporate-level criminal fines, confiscation of assets, and permanent denial of export zero-rating eligibility.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) / Ngân hàng Nhà nước Việt Nam
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: VND is only partially convertible in the international sense. Current-account transactions are legally convertible through SBV-licensed credit institutions under the Foreign Exchange Ordinance (Ordinance 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11, as amended) and Decree 70/2014/ND-CP; however, practical clearing requires full supporting documentation through a Vietnamese bank. Capital-account transactions are controlled: equity contributions, shareholder loans, profit repatriation, and liquidation proceeds must be routed through a registered Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at an SBV-licensed bank. Profit remittance to the foreign parent is permitted only after the audited annual financial statements have been approved, corporate income tax (CIT) finalisation has been completed and all taxes paid, statutory reserves are established, the members' meeting passes a distribution resolution, and the servicing bank verifies tax clearance. VND is not freely deliverable in offshore FX markets; offshore non-deliverable transactions cannot be used as the settlement currency for local VAT, CIT, payroll, or payments to domestic counterparties.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For an export-service business such as a TikTok/MCN agency, the statutory rule is repatriation, not a fixed percentage surrender. Export proceeds from services must be credited to a licensed bank account in Vietnam within 90 days from the service completion date unless an SBV-approved longer contractual deferral is arranged. There is no current mandatory percentage conversion ratio for MCN service receipts under Circular 05/2021/TT-NHNN; however, the SBV may impose emergency surrender of up to 100% in exceptional balance-of-payments situations, and under normal administrative practice any foreign-currency balance not backed by permitted FX expenditures (offshore creator payments, platform licensing fees, foreign loan service, permitted profit repatriations) must be converted to VND through the collecting bank. In effect, the LLC should plan for 100% conversion of net export-service proceeds after deducting approved FX-denominated operating needs.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as an ancillary collection/payout aggregator, but Low as a primary treasury settlement channel. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise B2B, Payoneer, Airwallex, and Currencycloud are not licensed by the SBV to open bank accounts, accept deposits, or provide VND clearing services in Vietnam. They may be used only as an offshore payment conduit so long as the final economic settlement lands in an SBV-licensed bank account of VN_LLC via a compliant SWIFT MT103 or a correspondent banking transfer. Legal constraints include risk of the EMI being treated as an unlicensed payment intermediary in Vietnam if used as the local collection account; therefore all export revenue must be booked and declared in Vietnam, and tax authorities will require bank statements from the licensed Vietnamese bank. The LLC should not maintain its primary treasury or tax-payment account outside the Vietnamese banking system.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence and face-to-face KYC are mandatory for all new corporate account openings for a 100% foreign-owned LLC. Non-resident directors and ultimate beneficial owners must appear in person before the bank's compliance officer, produce original passports, provide proof of residential address, and sign specimen signatures at the bank office. Remote opening is not permitted as a first-time onboarding path. If a foreign director cannot travel, a Vietnamese-resident director may attend with a notarised and apostilled Power of Attorney; the authorised representative must appear physically, and bank staff may still require a video interview with the foreign director. The bank will typically conduct a site visit to the registered address to verify operational substance, staff presence, and the availability of lease agreements; domiciled addresses without physical operations are a serious blocker.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: newly incorporated LLC in Vietnam with a digital-only MCN business, no traditional physical sales, and payments originating from offshore social-media platforms or from a global TikTok parent
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), tax registration certificate, members' charter, beneficial-ownership declaration, shareholder passports with source-of-funds declarations, global platform contract with TikTok/ByteDance, historical creator payout schedule prepared by the existing group, and a one-page treasury compliance policy signed by the legal representative.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: high-frequency, low-value remittances to a large number of individual creators, which may resemble unlicensed money transmission or payroll without employment registration
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete creator KYC file for the ten largest counterparties (passport/ID, Vietnamese tax ID, bank account details, signed influencer agreement, statement of services delivered, content deliverables, and payout calculations); full ledger of all creator payments with internal control evidence; invoices and VAT-compliant accounting records; confirmation that each creator is an independent contractor under VN_LLC's terms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: settlement through offshore fintech platforms (Wise B2B, TikTok Creator Marketplace payouts) creates an opaque correspondent chain and makes originator-beneficiary verification difficult
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed operational payment-flow diagram from offshore platform to VN_LLC's Vietnamese bank account; originator statements from the EMI or platform; copies of all intermediary SWIFT confirmations; a legal opinion confirming that the Vietnamese entity is the beneficial recipient of the remittance and that no unlicensed e-money services are being provided in Vietnam; indemnity undertaking acceptable to the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Underwriting red flag: insufficient taxable substance, particularly no payroll, no physical office, or inconsistent VAT/CIT declarations during the initial account event
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Long-term office or co-working lease with photos, employment contracts and social insurance participation evidence for local administrators/operations staff, corporate tax profile including VAT returns (0% export-service VAT, if applicable), CIT provisional payments, audited financial statements or internally prepared management accounts, and tax agent engagement letter confirming ongoing compliance.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All equity capital injections must be routed as cross-border wire transfers to the beneficiary's Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) at the chosen SBV-licensed bank. The remitter must be the foreign shareholder in whose name the equity contribution is registered under the IRC; third-party payments are not accepted. The SWIFT MT103 should include the shareholder's full name, the beneficiary account in the name of VN_LLC, and a purpose/remittance reference such as 'FDI equity contribution under Investment Registration Certificate No. [reference]'. The LLC must provide the IRC, ERC/charter, member capital contribution schedule, board resolution approving the capital call, and source-of-wealth pack. The local bank will verify that the incoming amount matches the committed capital schedule and will report the inflow to the SBV under the balance-of-payments framework. If the capital is received in a non-VND currency, it can remain in a foreign-currency sub-account or be converted to VND at the bank's telegraphic-transfer rate; no surrender ratio applies to capital injections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary outbound clearing rail for MCN creator settlements is SWIFT MT103 for cross-border services and the domestic NAPAS/FAST/VietQR rails for VND payments to Vietnamese creators. Commercial letters of credit are not the appropriate settlement mechanism for intangible creator services; if a large client insists on documentary security, use a standby LC or bank performance undertaking, with the final payment still effected by MT103 against invoices and milestone deliverables. Recurring international creator payments should be pre-approved as a beneficiary list, with each beneficiary's identity, contract, and tax status maintained in the treasury system. Local creator payouts should be made to verified Vietnamese bank accounts using service-purchase or fee-for-service codes, never as anonymous cash, and the bank will conduct sanctions screening and SBV balance-of-payments reporting. For high-volume TikTok payouts, establish a host-to-host API or corporate electronic-banking batch file with the bank to automate repetitive MT103 instructions while preserving audit trails.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward (USD/VND or CNY/VND) with a licensed bank, supported by an underlying current-account exposure such as signed creator agreements or platform revenue invoices; standard tenors follow the SBV's derivative framework and typically do not exceed 365 days.
FX swap (spot/forward combination) used to cover temporary mismatches between USD-denominated TikTok receipts and short-term VND operating-cost requirements, executed through the same licensed bank.

Cross-currency swap (CCS) linked to a registered foreign shareholder loan or a medium-term offshore financing transaction, permitted only if the underlying capital-account transaction is registered with the SBV and the bank has approved the treasury documentation.

Vanilla deliverable FX options (USD/VND call/put) available as an OTC hedging tool from licensed banks, exercised through the local banking system and recorded on the LLC's books as a hedge of committed foreign-currency cash flows.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF): not permissible as an onshore settlement or remittance instrument for VN_LLC; the offshore parent may use an NDF solely as an economic hedge outside Vietnam, but no VND settlement or local-bank involvement is permitted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements and corporate income tax finalization package (Báo cáo tài chính năm & Quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) under the General Department of Taxation, Vietnam Tax Administration Law
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end; calendar-year filers must submit no later than 30 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties of VND 4,000,000 to VND 40,000,000; late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on underpaid CIT; repeated non-filing may trigger forced tax assessment, independent audit, and administrative strike-off of enterprise registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements filing with the statistical authority (Báo cáo tài chính gửi cơ quan thống kê)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Statistics Office (Cục Thống kê) in coordination with the tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within the same 90-day anniversary period; calendar-year entities file before 30 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines of up to VND 30,000,000 for non-submission; persistent omission is recorded in the non-compliance record and can lead to forced audit and eventual administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business license fee declaration and payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department (Cục Thuế) of the company's registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 30 January each year for existing entities; newly established legal entities pay within 30 days of enterprise registration certificate issuance.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty for late payment of up to 15% of the underpaid license fee plus 0.03% per day interest; prolonged non-payment may lead to coercive collection and inclusion in administrative strike-off after 12 months of non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Compulsory independent audit applies to foreign-invested enterprises, public securities companies, state-controlled enterprises, and licensed banks/insurers; a foreign-invested LLC must therefore have annual financial statements audited under the Law on Accounting and Decree 174/2016/ND-CP.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC for statutory financial statements; IFRS is optional for specific public companies and consolidated group reporting by the ultimate parent.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not maintain a public annual UBO return. The LLC must identify ultimate beneficial owners at onboarding and whenever a share/capital transfer occurs. Each transfer must be reflected in the member register, approved by corporate minutes, and filed with the Department of Planning and Investment within 10 days. Annually, the legal representative must reconcile the member register with the shareholder ledger and confirm all UBO changes were documented and audited.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (with capital contributions, ownership percentages, and UBO data)
Register of Directors/Legal Representatives (including appointment and revocation records)
Minute Book (corporate resolutions, member meetings, and capital transfer approvals)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 200 - 500 per year for professional registered office and corporate secretarial agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 2,000 - 6,000 per year for a typical foreign-invested LLC statutory audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 20% standard Corporate Income Tax (CIT) rate. No statutory tax holiday applies to a pure ISIC 7310 advertising and creator-management agency; preferential regimes (10% for 15 years for high-tech enterprises, 2-year exemption plus 50% reduction for 4 years for eligible new investment projects) are inapplicable to MCN services. The entity may only reduce effective CIT through fully deductible operating expenses, accelerated amortization of intangible creator contracts, and the statutory 5-year loss carryforward. Global Minimum Top-Up Tax (Pillar Two, effective 1 January 2024) applies solely to multinational groups with consolidated revenue of at least EUR 750 million, which does not trigger for this LLC absent a qualifying MNE parent group.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 02/TNDN - Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế thu nhập doanh nghiệp) filed through the National e-Tax Portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn / thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) using the enterprise's registered e-signature token.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual finalization return covering each calendar year or permitted fiscal year; supplementary to four quarterly provisional payments made via Form 01/TNDN.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 90th day from the fiscal year-end. For a calendar-year LLC, the statutory deadline is 31 March of the following year. The deadline is not extended except under documented force majeure accepted by the General Department of Taxation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total business revenue from goods and services, including TikTok creator commissions, agency management fees, brand-sponsorship mark-ups, and platform-related advertising service income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report entire turnover in VND converted at the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV) average transaction rate on the invoice date; revenue settled on offshore TikTok or Wise rails must still be included in full.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-taxable revenue items, e.g., insurance indemnity for damaged business assets or government grant returns not qualifying as taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Rare for this LLC; foreign-owned MCN operations must not classify platform signing bonuses or retention payments as non-taxable unless covered by an explicit CIT exemption decree.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total deductible operating expenses: payroll and creator talent fees supported by labor contracts and mandatory social insurance filings, lawful e-invoices, office rent, marketing, amortization and depreciation per Circular 96/2015/TT-BTC conditions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cross-border payments to foreign creator affiliates are deductible only with written contracts, actual services rendered, valid transfer pricing documentation, and a Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) compliance trail; no deduction for distributed dividends or CIT paid at the owner level.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible expenses that must be added back to taxable income: unreceipted advances, illegal tender payments, fines, VAT not deductible, expenses lacking legal invoice substance, and 20% disallowance of certain entertainment expenses where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pro-foreign-investment LLC rules apply equally; add back any whisper creator payouts unrecorded in the Vietnamese legal invoice system.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable gross income before loss carryforward: Line 01 minus Line 02 minus Line 03 plus Line 04.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Computation follows audited financial statements; unaudited or foreign-only books trigger a tax officer re-computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current-year loss carryforward deducted from taxable income, limited to a maximum of five consecutive years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only documented losses reflected in Vietnamese audited accounts may be carried; foreign group losses cannot be imported into the LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income for the year after loss deduction.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders have no allocation right at this box; the LLC must not reduce the tax base by profit-repatriation targets.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT payable at 20% of Line 08: [Line 08] x 20%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No DTA reduction applies to corporate income tax computed at entity level; treaty relief only affects withholding taxes on outbound payments shown in separate schedules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Less provisional quarterly CIT payments already made under Form 01/TNDN for quarters one through four.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-owned LLC must ensure aggregate provisional installments reach at least 80% of the final liability; otherwise interest at 0.03%/day is charged from 31 January.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance of CIT due or overpayment credit after subtracting quarterly installments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Balance must be paid by the 90-day deadline; overpayment can be credited or refunded through a separate electronic tax procedure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of all transactions with related parties, including TikTok's offshore holding/affiliate structures, management fees, royalty/license fees, and intercompany creator platform settlements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Even if TP documentation thresholds are not met, the related-party disclosure schedule is mandatory and is a primary audit trigger for foreign-invested MCNs.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: formal warning for up to 2 days' delay; VND 2-5 million for 3-30 days; VND 6-12 million for 31-60 days; VND 14-20 million for 61-90 days; VND 16-25 million beyond 90 days or in cases of annex omissions. Late-payment interest accrues at 0.03% per day on the unpaid CIT from the statutory deadline. Recurrent non-filing triggers presumptive assessment, bank account freezes, suspension of e-invoice issuance, and temporary exit suspension for the legal representative.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 01/TNDN - Provisional Quarterly Corporate Income Tax Return filed through the National e-Tax Portal (etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Quarterly provisional filing and payment, covering each three-month period of the fiscal year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 30th day of the first month of the following quarter: Q1 by 30 April, Q2 by 30 July, Q3 by 30 October, Q4 by 30 January.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated quarterly revenue from creator management, TikTok payouts, and advertising services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Estimate on a realizable basis; understating estimates to defer tax creates 80%-rule exposure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated deductible expenses for the quarter, including creator talent costs and marketing spend.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-affiliate payments require the same evidentiary standard as in the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated taxable income for the quarter.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be computed on Vietnamese accounting principles, not on group consolidation.
Same headline rate; no foreign tax credit is claimed at quarterly stage unless supported by annual finalization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative tax already paid in earlier quarters.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Carry the exact figures from prior Form 01/TNDN files.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Amount payable in the current quarter: Box 04 minus Box 05.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay via the national e-Tax portal; foreign exchange conversion must use SBV intervention rate on the date of payment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Underpayment of the annual CIT final liability by more than 80% of the provisional total triggers late-payment interest of 0.03%/day on the shortfall from 31 January. Quarterly filing violations carry administrative fines under Decree 125/2020 of up to VND 25 million per return plus daily interest on unpaid provisional tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Since 1 January 2016, Vietnam abolished the Profit Remittance Tax on after-tax earnings distributed to foreign corporate shareholders. A foreign-invested LLC may remit annual post-CIT profits to its foreign corporate owner without Vietnamese withholding tax, provided the distribution is approved by the members' meeting, based on audited financial statements, and after full CIT finalization. Non-resident individual shareholders remain subject to 5% Personal Income Tax withholding on dividend distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke Double Taxation Relief for outbound payments (royalty, interest, and other income), the Vietnamese LLC must receive, before or at the payment date, a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign recipient's tax authority, accompanied by a notarized Vietnamese translation and, where required, legalization/consular certification. The LLC must file the TRC and supporting computations with the annual Form 02/TNDN package through the e-Tax portal; absent a TRC at the time of payment, statutory Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) rates must be withheld, and subsequent over-withholding is recoverable via a tax offset or refund claim under the Tax Administration Law. The Principal Purpose Test under the BEPS Multilateral Instrument is applied when assessing whether the DTA claim is available to shell or conduit recipients.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory Foreign Contractor Tax equals 15% aggregate on gross remittances (5% deemed VAT plus 10% CIT). Most Vietnamese DTAs cap the CIT portion at 10% for royalties, yielding a residual net tax of 10% CIT plus 5% VAT (total 15%) because the VAT component is not treaty-protected. Interest: statutory FCT rate is 5% CIT on gross interest with no VAT; although several DTAs set a 10% limitation, Vietnam's lower domestic rate of 5% applies. The LLC must withhold on each cross-border payment via the e-Tax FCT declaration and register a foreign-contractor withholding certificate.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP Article 19: (i) Local File is mandatory when the taxpayer's aggregate related-party transaction value exceeds VND 30 billion (~USD 1.2 million) in a fiscal year; (ii) Master File is mandatory when the ultimate parent's worldwide consolidated revenue reaches approximately VND 500 billion and the Vietnamese taxpayer engages in related-party transactions; (iii) Country-by-Country Report applies to groups with consolidated revenue of at least VND 18,000 billion (~USD 750 million). Taxpayers with total annual revenue below VND 50 billion and related-party transactions below VND 30 billion are exempt from preparing formal documentation but must still complete the Form 01 related-party disclosure attached to the CIT finalization return.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vietnam does not apply UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations; however, Article 74 of the Tax Administration Law No. 38/2019/QH14 and Decree 132/2020/ND-CP mandate a substance-over-form assessment. Transactions lacking commercial rationale or conferring purely artificial tax benefits may be recharacterized by the General Department of Taxation. The BEPS MLI Principal Purpose Test additionally denies DTA benefits where the arrangement was designed primarily to secure treaty relief. In practice, the LLC must demonstrate physical office presence, locally resident management, payroll substance, enforceable creator contracts, active business decision-making in Vietnam, and assumption of commercial risk.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion - deliberate understatement of CIT
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Recording only a fraction of gross TikTok creator commissions and agency management fees; using unreported offshore Wise or Creator Payout accounts; issuing or using false e-invoices to inflate creator-related costs; booking foreign owner personal expenses as LLC deductible charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative: 20% penalty on the understated CIT plus late-payment interest of 0.03% per day (Decree 125/2020/ND-CP). Criminal: when evaded tax equals or exceeds VND 100 million and constitutes at least 10% of the true tax liability, Penal Code No. 100/2015/QH13 (amended 2017) Article 223 imposes on the legal entity a fine up to VND 5 billion, suspension of operations up to 5 years, or forced dissolution for serious recidivism.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The board chairman/managing director signing false CIT returns faces personal criminal fine of VND 100-500 million, up to 7 years' imprisonment, and restitution of the evaded tax. Under Decree 126/2020/ND-CP, temporary exit suspension automatically applies to the legal representative where the company's tax debt exceeds VND 10 million and remains overdue for more than 90 days; personal assets can be attached where transfers to nominee offshore entities were made to frustrate collection.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Profit Shifting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying phantom management fees to a TikTok offshore affiliate, round-tripping creator talent payments through related Singapore or British Virgin Islands holding accounts, charging inflated software/license royalties without a CUP, and failing to prepare a Local File despite related-party flows exceeding VND 30 billion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax officers recharacterize the arrangements under OECD-compliant arm's-length analysis, disallow the inflated deductions, assess additional CIT, apply a 20% understatement penalty, and levy 0.03%/day interest on the deficiency for the entire period from the original deadline; the statute of limitations extends to 10 years where fraudulent concealment of related-party transactions is proven.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors cannot shield behind the LLC veil when sham contracts are the operative mechanism: the managing director is jointly liable for the additional CIT and penalties, the DTA/PPT relief is revoked, the e-Tax declaration is treated as knowingly false, and the responsible individual is exposed to criminal tax evasion charges under Article 223 and to exit ban enforcement under Decree 126/2020.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company or Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining only a virtual office address, appointing nominee directors, holding no local employees, and outsourcing all strategic decision-making to a foreign TikTok headquarter unequipped with a permanent establishment in Vietnam; using the LLC solely as a profit-shifting conduit while the beneficial foreign owner orchestrates all creator contracts offshore.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The General Department of Taxation invokes Article 74 Law 38/2019 to deny the corporate taxpayer characterization for the arrangement, reattribute the Vietnamese-source income to the foreign beneficial owner, and assess additional CIT with a 20% penalty and daily interest. Enterprise registration sanctions under Decree 122/2021/ND-CP apply for false registered information, and the LLC may be forced into dissolution where it has no real business; tax debt enforcement includes asset seizures and bank account freezes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee directors remain personally liable for the accuracy of registered filings and may be sanctioned with fines of VND 50-100 million; where the shell structure is used to evade tax or launder creator payouts, directors face criminal prosecution under Articles 223 and 324 of the Penal Code, travel bans, and personal restitution orders when the LLC's assets prove insufficient to satisfy the tax judgment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Remitting royalties, software licensing fees, creator-management fees, or interest to foreign payees without withholding the mandatory FCT under Circular 103/2014/TT-BTC, or failing to register a TRC before treaty-reduced rates are applied.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The LLC is jointly assessed for the un-withheld FCT at 15% (royalty: 5% VAT plus 10% CIT) or 5% (interest) on the gross remittance, plus a penalty of 20% of the under-withheld amount under Decree 125/2020 and late-payment interest of 0.03%/day backdated to each payment date; the corresponding expense is disallowed in the LLC's CIT computation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The managing director who signs remittance instructions without satisfying FCT obligations is personally and jointly liable for the tax arrears under the Tax Administration Law; enforcement measures include travel bans, suspension of bank payment authorization, and, where the omission was intentional and part of a tax evasion scheme, criminal liability under Penal Code Article 223 with imprisonment of up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Foreign Exchange Violations through Offshore Payment Rails
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving TikTok Creator Payouts in USD/EUR directly into Wise Business or foreign bank accounts without routing through a licensed Vietnamese commercial bank; failing to declare the beneficial ownership of the LLC under the Anti-Money Laundering Law 2022 and Decree 19/2023; structuring multiple small inbound transfers to avoid e-tax visibility.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign exchange violations are fined under the State Bank sanctions regime at up to VND 1 billion for organizations; AML due-diligence infractions attract fines of VND 400 million to 1 billion under Decree 19/2023 sanction provisions; unlicensed cross-border money services can trigger criminal money-laundering charges under Penal Code Article 324, resulting in 1-10 years' imprisonment for responsible parties; all undeclared offshore receipts are additionally treated as undeclared taxable revenue subject to reassessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who establish or authorize offshore payout accounts in the LLC's name are primary subjects of criminal AML enforcement, face bank account freezes, exit suspensions, and fines of up to VND 500 million or imprisonment of up to 10 years; the corporate veil is pierced for restitution when creator proceeds are diverted to personal or foreign-entity accounts in a manner designed to evade Vietnamese tax and foreign-exchange control.
